tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun bla ma yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan la brten nas rgyas pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bha wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che baiḍūr+ya sngon po'i sa gzhi 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi mig mangs ris su bris pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya las 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa/ g.yon mnyam bzhag zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas klubs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can/ de'i mtha' skor du rtsa brgyud gyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas skor bar gyur/ oṃ gu ru rat+na saṃ bha wa sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pa d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhup+pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi t+ye/ shap+ta/ mahā sarba a mṛ ta bo dhi tsit+ta a ho mahā su kha ā hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum brjod/ maṇ+ḍal lan gsum la sogs pa ci mang dbul/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan gyis bdag gi brgyud byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i dbul phongs bskres skom gyi sdug bsngal thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang / tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa dbang phyug snyan grags lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

ces sogs yid la gang 'dod kyi gsol ba phur tshugs su btab/ de nas bla ma'i phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya las 'dod dgu'i char babs pas/ bdag nyid kyi re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing / bla ma dam pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad 'od du zhu nas bdag la thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa dang / rang gi lus ngag yid bya byed dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres shing rang nyid kyang bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi skur gyur pa'i phyag gi mchog sbyin las 'dod dgu'i char babs pas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad tshim par byas/ de thams cad kyang bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan du gyur nas/ slar yang rang nyid la 'dod dgu'i dngos grub byin par bsam/ de ltar bsam pa thams cad kyang legs par rtags na rang gi sems nyid kho na'i rnam 'phrul yin cing sems kyi ngo bo gsal stong zung 'jug brjod pa'i mtha' dang bral bar bsam nas/ 'dzin med kyi ngang du lus sems khong klod nas ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par 'jog rjes su skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang sogs dang / thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du sogs bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa brjod/ 'di ni thun gcig gi rgyun gyi nyams len gyi rim pa la/ tshul 'di lta bus thun bzhir bcad de maṇ+ḍal dang gsol btab du nan tan du byas nas zhag bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa'i bar du 'bad rtsol du nyams su blangs pas/ dngos sam nyams/ rmi lam ci rigs par rgyas pa'i las 'grub pa'i rtags gsal bar 'byung zhing / zla ba mi thogs par grub mtha' rnyogs pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par gsungs pas/ nyams len gyi rim pa la brtson par bya'o/ /rje btsun bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /brten nas rgyas pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /sa skya'i rje btsun mchog gi thugs bcud 'di/

/bla ma'i bran gyur blo gsal rgya mtshos sbyar/ /de las byung ba'i rab dkar dge ba'i las/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser zhun lta bu des/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mi dbang 'khor bcas kyi/ /chab srid yar ngo'i zla dbang ltar rgyas shog /ces pa'i yi ge pa ni bla ma'i bka' 'bangs 'a zhwa'i ben+dhes bgyis so/ /bkra shis/ ces pa 'di yang yar lung mchog sprul rin po che'i phyag dpe las zhal shus pa dge legs 'phel// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan la brten nas rgyas pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
